messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: Problem when fitting interval censored regression models
parts:
Dear Stan Team,

I am currently working on implementing interval censoring in brms and I have problems reproducing results of other packages and also experience some convergence issues.
I assume it's a bug in my Stan code but I seem to be unable to find it....  Attached is the Stancode, data, and an R script allowing to reproduce my problem.

Maybe you see what is happening. Many thanks for your help!

All the best,
Paul

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Problem when fitting interval censored regression models
parts:
This part is wrong:

else if (cens[n] == 2)
target += exponential_lcdf(rcens[n] | eta[n]) -
exponential_lcdf(Y[n] | eta[n]);

Check out the discussion in the manual and how we generate intervals.
You want the diff of the lcdfs to be on the linear scale, so you
need

log_diff_exp(exponential_lcdf(rcens[n] | eta[n]),
exponential_lcdf(Y[n] | eta[n]));

with basic definition

log_diff_exp(a, b) = log(exp(a) - exp(b))

You also have to be careful with discrete distributions because
the cdf is inclusive and the ccdf exclusive of bounds, and it
matters with discretes (I'm fixing the bug in Stan related to this
right now).

- Bob
